title: Conformance fixture: logged session
description: What an athlete actually recorded for a resolved Session, as consumed by progress() (spec/semantics/progression.md § Inputs). One entry per SetRef the athlete logged performance for.

label.description: The `set` label this entry logs, matching ProgressionRule.target for progressable sets.

performedTarget.description: Reps completed, distance covered, or duration held — whichever `target.kind` the resolved SetRef used.

performedLoad.description: Weight actually used, if the set had a `load`.
